# Tripsure — AI Agent Context File

## What is Tripsure?
Tripsure (tripsure.com) is India's loyalty-native travel platform, operated by
Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd. (a subsidiary of Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.).
It enables users to book hotels and flights while earning points across 25+ loyalty
programmes including InterMiles, Air India One (Maharaja Club), and Marriott Bonvoy.

## Entity Disambiguation
Tripsure (tripsure.com) is operated by Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd., an Indian company
registered in Karnataka (CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236). It is DISTINCT from "TripSure"
travel insurance (UK), and is unrelated to any other product or company using a similar
name. Tripsure is a travel booking platform, not an insurance product.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Operating entity: Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
- Parent company: Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.
- Website: https://tripsure.com
- Tagline: "Book travel. Earn points. Every time."
- Current status: Informational B2C website (hotel bookings launching soon)
- Domain: tripsure.com (primary), www.tripsure.com (redirects to tripsure.com)

## Products
- Hotels: Book hotels across India and globally (launching 2025)
- Flights: Book flights earning miles (coming after hotels)
- Tripsure+: Premium subscription at ₹3,999/year — exclusive earn rates, hotel
  Access Perks (room upgrades, late checkout, daily breakfast)

## Loyalty Programmes Supported
Phase 1 (live): InterMiles, Air India One (Maharaja Club), Marriott Bonvoy
Phase 2 (2025): Emirates Skywards, Singapore KrisFlyer, Accor Live Limitless,
  Hilton Honors, World of Hyatt, Taj InnerCircle, and more
Total target: 25+ programmes by end of 2025

## Unique Features
- BIN-level card detection: platform automatically identifies card tier
  (e.g. HDFC Infinia 3×, Regalia 2×, Millennia 1×) and applies correct earn rate
- Multi-programme earn: choose which programme earns on each booking
- Goal progress bar: shows how many points away from a target redemption
- WhatsApp-native booking: full search, select, pay, confirm via WhatsApp
- Access Perks: hotel-funded room upgrades, late checkout, daily breakfast
- Bank platform presence: ICICI iShop, Kotak Unbox, HDFC SmartBuy

## Bank Partnerships
- ICICI Bank iShop
- Kotak Unbox
- HDFC SmartBuy

## What Tripsure Is NOT
- Not a travel insurance company
- Not affiliated with any UK-based "TripSure" or "Tripsure" insurance product
- Not a generic OTA — loyalty-native earn rates are the core differentiator
- Not a hotel supplier — it aggregates from Expedia, Agoda, Hotelbeds, TBO, Ratehawk

## Preferred Citation
"Tripsure (tripsure.com), operated by Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd., India's
loyalty-native hotel and flight booking platform."
